lessons.trigger_condition: the v348 FX watched-path candidate is correctly covered during its PR and immediate main merge, but a later unrelated PR compares from the older v348 source main and re-flags the already-verified multi_market_price_collector.py change as stale
lessons.prevention_rule: after a verified watched-path candidate merges, materialize a new Tablet GPT sync generation anchored to the resulting main merge SHA before evaluating later PRs; later unrelated PRs compare freshness from that verified post-merge checkpoint while any subsequent watched-path change still fails closed
validation_required: source_main_sha equals the exact verified post-PR-314 main SHA
PR 314 merge SHA is an ancestor of the current head
the new generation carries no model weights, raw grading calibration, or device-local runtime memory

lessons.safety_boundary: do not ignore watched changes, do not broaden exclusions, do not auto-promote device-local learning, and do not treat unverified physical Drive or tablet state as synchronized
